text: dsh-loader 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Cordis 兼容插件：按 DSH 版本选择适配器，并向其他插件提供稳定的设置、网络、服务、注册表、模型和补丁 API。它还提供配置模板持久化、浏览器端模块别名与配置界面能力，帮助第三方插件跨版本运行并构建设置表单。适合维护 DSH 插件及其配置界面的开发者。需要 Node.js 24.9.0 或更高版本，并安装到 DSH profile；不要求额外 API 密钥。

dsh-loader helps DSH Cordis plugins work across supported host versions by selecting a matching adapter. It provides stable APIs, persistent configuration, browser module aliases, and configuration forms. For DSH plugin developers. Requires Node.js 24.9.0 or later.

dsh-loader 的功能「版本适配」：检测当前 DSH 版本并从注册表挑选匹配适配器，供第三方 Cordis 插件跨版本使用；不支持的版本会明确报错。
dsh-loader 的功能「稳定宿主 API」：加载后通过 dshLoader 暴露设置、网络、服务、注册表、LLM、DSH 符号和补丁能力，供其他插件调用。
dsh-loader 的功能「插件配置存储」：插件注册带字段模板的配置，宿主提供读取、更新、重置和变更订阅，并将配置保存在当前 profile 的插件目录。
dsh-loader 的功能「浏览器兼容与配置 UI」：客户端入口安装模块兼容层并挂载配置界面，向插件提供 UI 服务及模块别名解析支持。
dsh-loader 的功能「Profile 接入」：setup 命令将依赖和 Cordis patch 项写入指定 profile，便于启用兼容层。
dsh-loader 使用前须知：它只为注册表覆盖的 DSH 版本选择适配器；无法检测版本或版本不受支持时会停止加载并报错。
dsh-loader 使用前须知：运行时要求 Node.js >=24.9.0，且配置数据写入 DSH profile 下 config/<插件ID>/config.json。

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · English：dsh-loader **2.0.0** provides independent adapters for dsh patch releases, stable host capability facades, client UI helpers, and a new configuration API with centrally generated forms.

Supported patch families: `0.1.5`, `0.1.6`, `0.1.7`, `0.2.0`, `0.2.1`, `0.2.2`, including prereleases. The published release inventory and dependency resolution are frozen on 2026-10-30. Unknown patches, majors, and older versions are rejected. Requires Node >=24.9.0.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · Install：```sh
npm run build
npm pack
node bin/dshloader.mjs setup <profile-name>
npm install --prefix <profile-directory> <absolute-path-to-dsh-plugin-dsh-loader-2.0.0.tgz>

`setup` writes the dependency and Cordis patch to the named profile. Install the locally packed archive into that same profile, then restart dsh. These commands do not publish the package.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · Install：Inject `dshLoader` to access `config`, `settings`, `web`, `services`, `registry`, `llm`, `dsh`, and `patch`. The client entry is `@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader/client`; host module subpaths have explicit ESM and CJS exports.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · Configuration：Register a JSON template through `config.register(ownerCtx, template)`. Values persist at `<profile>/config/<pluginID>/config.json`, independently of host settings and `exposeAllNamespaces`. Templates support groups, objects, arrays, passwords, validation, and declarative visibility.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · Configuration：Templates can also declare transient operation panels with host handlers registered through `handle.registerOperation()`: async options, selection-to-editor bindings, editing/import, read-only Markdown/list/JSON results, cancellable long tasks, and resource revision conflicts. Operation drafts never enter the configuration file.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · Configuration：Fields can also open custom dialogs registered by the client through `dshLoaderUi.config.registerDialog()`. Plugins provide a React UI and a data reader; `.save()` and the Confirm button share revision-checked configuration persistence, retaining editor contents on failure.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-loader README · Configuration：Before dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2, forms appear under More → Settings → Plugin configuration. Newer versions use the corresponding native plugin detail page. Every plugin has a collapsed card with measured equal-width labels and fieldset groups. Save, cancel, and restore-defaults work per card; failed or conflicting saves preserve drafts.
